record.paper_title: New results and open problems on Toeplitz operators in Bergman spaces
record.original_question: Determine exactly when Hankel operators are bounded and when they are compact on L^1 in the Bergman-space setting, so that one can extend the Fredholm theory of Toeplitz operators on the Bergman space A^1.

evidence.quote: Problem 7. Determine when Hankel operators are bounded and compact on L1, in order to extend Fredholm theory of Toeplitz operators on the Bergman space A1.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D}$ denote the open unit disk in $\mathbb{C}$ with normalized area measure $dA$. For $1 \le p < \infty$, let $L^p = L^p(\mathbb{D}, dA)$ and let the Bergman space $A^p \subset L^p$ be the closed subspace of holomorphic functions in $L^p$. Let $P : L^2 \to A^2$ be the orthogonal Bergman projection, given by 
$$ (Pf)(z) = \int_{\mathbb{D}} \frac{f(w)}{(1-z\bar w)^2}\, dA(w), $$
which extends to a bounded operator on $L^p$ for $1 < p < \infty$.

For a measurable symbol $f$ on $\mathbb{D}$, define the Hankel operator with symbol $f$ formally by
$$ H_f g = (I - P)(fg), $$
acting on suitable holomorphic functions $g$. 

Problem. Give a complete characterization of those symbols $f$ for which the Hankel operator $H_f$ is (i) bounded on $L^1(\mathbb{D}, dA)$ (in an appropriate sense, e.g. as an operator from $A^1$ to $L^1/A^1$ or to a suitable companion space), and (ii) compact in the same setting. The characterization should be sufficient to develop a Fredholm theory for Toeplitz operators $T_f = P M_f$ on the Bergman space $A^1$.
artifact.category_tag: Hankel and Toeplitz operators on Bergman spaces
artifact.status_search_result: While complete characterizations of boundedness and compactness of Hankel operators on the Bergman space $A^p$ for $1 < p < \infty$ are classical (Luecking 1992, and recent IDA-based characterizations on Fock and weighted Bergman spaces), the $L^1$/$A^1$ endpoint case relevant to extending Fredholm theory of Toeplitz operators on $A^1$ does not appear to have a definitive complete characterization in the literature. Status is inconclusive from the available search.

status_evidence.title: IDA and Hankel operators on Fock spaces
status_evidence.snippet: a notion of integral distance to holomorphic functions (IDA) was introduced to completely characterize boundedness and compactness of Hankel operators
status_evidence.claim: Recent characterizations using IDA address boundedness and compactness in Fock/Bergman settings, but not specifically the $L^1$ endpoint for $A^1$ Fredholm theory.

status_evidence.title: IDA function and asymptotic behavior of singular values of Hankel operators on weighted Bergman spaces
status_evidence.snippet: characterizations of boundedness and compactness of Hankel operators on weighted Bergman spaces
status_evidence.claim: Active recent research extends characterizations to weighted Bergman spaces; $L^1$ endpoint is not addressed in a way that closes the question.
